changelog: BIM-Bot v2.7.4 — OpenCode support and the Navisworks <-> Revit bridge session. NEW: OpenCode is auto-connected like Claude and ChatGPT (installer, Revit startup self-heal and the Connect Claude button write ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json); BIM-Bot tools stay hidden from OpenCode coding agents and appear in a dedicated BIM-Bot agent with checkpoint-before-write rules. NEW: manual bridge session — Navisworks Add-ins > BIM-Bot Bridge makes Navisworks the master and lists its discipline models; the Revit Join Bridge button attaches each open document as a slave, so navis_clash_to_revit selects and zooms both sides of a cross-discipline clash in the right Revit window; new navis_bridge_status. bimbot-doctor now checks OpenCode.
